final: WITH member_major AS (SELECT m.member_id, ma.department FROM member m INNER JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id), dept_counts AS (SELECT department, COUNT(*) as count FROM member_major GROUP BY department), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM dept_counts), with_share AS (SELECT d.department, d.count, CAST(d.count AS FLOAT) / t.total as share FROM dept_counts d CROSS JOIN total_sum t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as average_share FROM with_share) SELECT w.department, w.count, w.share, w.share - a.average_share as share_minus_avg FROM with_share w CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE w.share > a.average_share ORDER BY w.department
